short.q: Give three tips for reading aloud clearly in Mandarin.
short.answer: Look at the whole line first; find the tones; read slowly and clearly; pause at punctuation; speak loudly enough for everyone.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write in Chinese with pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door."
short.answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese with pinyin: "I like to drink tea."
short.answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

short.q: Draw a plan of a home with a garden, door, window and sofa and write four sentences about where things are, in Chinese with pinyin.
short.answer: For example 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian. 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
short.working: 1 mark for the plan and 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Give two habits of an active listener.
short.answer: Face the speaker and stay quiet; listen for key words; nod or show you are following.
short.working: 1 mark for each habit.

short.q: Write a short conversation of three lines in which two learners greet each other, give their names and ask "And you?". Include pinyin.
short.answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好!我叫安娜。你呢? nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào Ānnà. nǐ ne? A: 我叫小明。 wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct greeting line and 1 mark each for the name sentences, 1 mark for correct pinyin tone marks, 5 in total.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I drink tea."
short.answer: 我喝茶。 wǒ hē chá.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Explain one way rain helps the environment and one way too much rain harms it.
short.answer: Rain gives water to crops, rivers and animals. Too much rain can cause floods that damage crops and homes.
short.working: 2 marks for the benefit and 2 marks for the harm.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." and "Today it rains."
short.answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà. 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" and "When is your birthday?"
short.answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Rearrange and translate: 休息 / 星期六 / 在家 / 我.
short.answer: 我星期六在家休息。 On Saturday I rest at home.
short.working: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 杯子 and 午饭.
short.answer: 杯子: bēizi, cup. 午饭: wǔfàn, lunch.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
short.answer: The television is on the table.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my mouth to speak."
short.answer: 我用嘴巴说。 wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Explain the difference between skimming and scanning.
short.answer: Skimming is reading quickly to get the main idea. Scanning is looking for one particular word or fact.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
short.answer: I like to drink tea.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write a paragraph of four sentences about your week in Chinese with pinyin, using the days and activities from this lesson.
short.answer: 星期一到星期五,我去学校。星期六,我在家休息。星期天,我去教堂。 xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, wǒ qù xuéxiào. xīngqīliù, wǒ zài jiā xiūxi. xīngqītiān, wǒ qù jiàotáng.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for order and punctuation. Any sensible activities.

short.q: Explain what stress is in reading aloud and give an example.
short.answer: Stress means saying an important word a little stronger. For example in 我们切蛋糕, you may stress 蛋糕 to show what we cut. It does not change the tone.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for the tone note.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Thank you!"
short.answer: 谢谢! xièxie!
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Read the rhyme 妈妈骑马,马慢,妈妈骂马 and explain how the tone changes meaning.
short.answer: Māma qí mǎ, mǎ màn, māma mà mǎ. Mum rides a horse, the horse is slow, mum scolds the horse. The syllable ma changes meaning with the tone: mā mother, mǎ horse, mà scold.
short.working: 1 mark for the pinyin, 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for explaining the three ma words.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sun is very big."
short.answer: 太阳很大。 tàiyáng hěn dà.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Name the three parts of a Mandarin syllable.
short.answer: An initial, a final and a tone.
short.working: 1 mark for two parts and 1 mark for all three.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the television?"
short.answer: 电视在哪儿? diànshì zài nǎr?
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Wednesday I go to school."
short.answer: 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Break the syllables hǎo, jiào and nǐ into initial and final.
short.answer: hǎo = h + ao; jiào = j + iao; nǐ = n + i.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct syllable.

short.q: What is the job of 吗 in a sentence? Give an example.
short.answer: 吗 makes a yes-or-no question, for example 电视在桌子上吗?
short.working: 1 mark for the job and 1 mark for the example.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.
short.answer: The window is above the sofa.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I have two eyes."
short.answer: 我有两只眼睛。 wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nà shì wǒ dìdi.
short.answer: That is my younger brother.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.
short.answer: I have two eyes.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my older brother."
short.answer: 那是我哥哥。 nà shì wǒ gēge.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very light."
short.answer: 风很小。 fēng hěn xiǎo.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Explain one similarity and one difference between naming the days in Kiswahili and Chinese.
short.answer: Similarity: both use numbers to make day names. Difference: Chinese counts from Monday (星期一 is week one) but Kiswahili counts from Saturday (Jumatatu, Monday, has tatu, three).
short.working: 2 marks for the similarity and 2 marks for the difference with an example.

short.q: Explain how you can guess the meaning of 咖啡 in 我喝咖啡.
short.answer: The verb 喝 means to drink, so 咖啡 must be a drink. A picture can also help.
short.working: 1 mark for the verb clue, 1 mark for the conclusion, 1 mark for another clue.

short.q: Write three birthday activities in Chinese or English.
short.answer: 切蛋糕 (cut the cake), 送礼物 (give gifts), 唱歌 (sing), 和朋友一起玩 (play with friends). Any three.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: How do you write ü after j, q and x? Give one example.
short.answer: It is written as u, for example qù (to go).
short.working: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the example.

short.q: Give two words with the final -ao and one with the final -ang, with pinyin.
short.answer: For example 好 hǎo, 小 xiǎo; 房 fáng.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 再见 and 号.
short.answer: 再见: zàijiàn, goodbye. 号: hào, date (day of the month).
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Give two reasons why it is important to place household items in their right places.
short.answer: It keeps the house tidy and safe, and it is easier to find things.
short.working: 1 mark for each reason.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my mother."
short.answer: 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write the first two strokes of 右 and the first two strokes of 左.
short.answer: 右: 撇 then 横. 左: 横 then 撇.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct stroke pair and 1 mark for the difference.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The window is above the sofa."
short.answer: 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 爱 and 星期天.
short.answer: 爱: ài, love. 星期天: xīngqītiān, Sunday.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 三 and 来.
short.answer: 三: sān, three. 来: lái, to come.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 前面 and 房子.
short.answer: 前面: qiánmiàn, in front of. 房子: fángzi, house.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: What does it mean to listen for gist? Give one way to do it.
short.answer: Listening for gist means finding the main idea. You can listen for key words you already know.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a method.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." and "I use my ears to hear."
short.answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!"
short.answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo!
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Saturday I rest at home."
short.answer: 我星期六在家休息。 wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: State three rules of stroke order and give an example of each.
short.answer: Top to bottom (三), left to right (好: 女 then 子), horizontal before vertical (十), 撇 before 捺 (人).
short.working: 1 mark for each rule with an example.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 洪水 and 脚.
short.answer: 洪水: hóngshuǐ, flood. 脚: jiǎo, foot.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 儿子 and 刀.
short.answer: 儿子: érzi, son. 刀: dāo, knife.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒmen qiē dàngāo.
short.answer: We cut the cake.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?"
short.answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme?
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 盘子 and 几.
short.answer: 盘子: pánzi, plate. 几: jǐ, which number, how many.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Describe how to make a birthday card from recycled materials. Give three steps.
short.answer: Fold recycled card or paper; decorate the front; write 祝你生日快乐! neatly inside; sign your name. Reusing materials reduces waste.
short.working: 1 mark for each step and 1 mark for the recycling reason.

short.q: Write a sentence asking when a friend's birthday is, and a sentence answering that your birthday is on 10 May. Include pinyin.
short.answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? 我的生日是五月十号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì wǔ yuè shí hào.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Arrange the words to make a sentence and translate: 礼物 / 送 / 朋友 / 我.
short.answer: 朋友送我礼物。 My friend gives me a gift.
short.working: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bathroom is beside the garden."
short.answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Name the days of the week from Monday to Wednesday in Chinese with pinyin.
short.answer: 星期一 xīngqīyī, 星期二 xīngqī'èr, 星期三 xīngqīsān.
short.working: 1 mark for each day.

short.q: Blend the syllables zhuō and zi and give the meaning.
short.answer: zhuōzi, table.
short.working: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Give two things to put in a reading journal.
short.answer: New words with pinyin and meaning, sentences you can read well, or a recording of yourself reading.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Good morning!"
short.answer: 早上好! zǎoshang hǎo!
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: A picture shows a girl but the label says 儿子. Is the pair 对 or 错? Explain.
short.answer: 错 (wrong). 儿子 means son, but the picture shows a girl.
short.working: 1 mark for saying 错 and 1 mark for the reason.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 客厅 and 芒果.
short.answer: 客厅: kètīng, living room. 芒果: mángguǒ, mango.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 早饭 and 饼.
short.answer: 早饭: zǎofàn, breakfast. 饼: bǐng, flat bread.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Read jiào, nǐ and hǎo and write each with its Chinese character and meaning.
short.answer: 叫 jiào (to be called), 你 nǐ (you), 好 hǎo (good).
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期五, 切 and 桌子.
short.answer: 星期五: xīngqīwǔ, Friday. 切: qiē, to cut. 桌子: zhuōzi, table.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Tomorrow is Thursday."
short.answer: 明天是星期四。 míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Give one challenge of writing Chinese and one way to overcome it.
short.answer: For example, remembering stroke order; practise a few characters each day and use flashcards.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.
short.answer: Tomorrow is Thursday.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 月 and 太阳.
short.answer: 月: yuè, month. 太阳: tàiyáng, sun.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello! (polite)"
short.answer: 您好! nín hǎo!
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 云 and 牙.
short.answer: 云: yún, cloud. 牙: yá, tooth.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Give three steps of good imitation when learning a new word.
short.answer: Listen to the whole word, repeat it slowly, compare with the speaker and correct.
short.working: 1 mark for each step.

short.q: Write five sentences about body parts and what they do, with pinyin.
short.answer: 我用眼睛看。我用耳朵听。我用嘴巴说。我有两只手。我有两只脚。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng. wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī shǒu. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī jiǎo.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence with correct pinyin.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 蔬菜 and 他们.
short.answer: 蔬菜: shūcài, vegetables. 他们: tāmen, they.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Put these words in order and translate: 在 / 电视 / 上 / 桌子.
short.answer: 电视在桌子上。 The television is on the table.
short.working: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。and pinyin optional, 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The garden is on the right of the house."
short.answer: 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Describe where three things are in a house using 在. Write the Chinese and the meaning.
short.answer: For example: 床在卧室 (the bed is in the bedroom); 冰箱在厨房 (the fridge is in the kitchen); 电视在客厅 (the television is in the living room).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for the meanings.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "When is your birthday?"
short.answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write in Chinese and pinyin: "The wind is very strong."
short.answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

short.q: Write a plan for a model house: name four rooms or things in Chinese with pinyin and write one sentence about it.
short.answer: For example 厨房 chúfáng, 客厅 kètīng, 卧室 wòshì, 床 chuáng. Sentence: 床在卧室。
short.working: 1 mark for each name with pinyin, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 大家 and 干旱.
short.answer: 大家: dàjiā, everybody. 干旱: gānhàn, drought.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 清真寺 and 姐姐.
short.answer: 清真寺: qīngzhēnsì, mosque. 姐姐: jiějie, older sister.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Explain when we use 吃 and when we use 喝.
short.answer: We use 吃 with foods to say eat, and we use 喝 with drinks to say drink.
short.working: 1 mark for each verb.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to drink tea."
short.answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom."
short.answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write three actions of the body and the part that does each.
short.answer: For example 看 with the eyes, 听 with the ears, 说 with the mouth.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct pair.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We cut the cake."
short.answer: 我们切蛋糕。 wǒmen qiē dàngāo.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: yǔ hěn dà.
short.answer: The rain is heavy.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write two foods from each group: fruit and meat, with pinyin.
short.answer: Fruit: 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo. Meat: 牛肉 niúròu, 鸡肉 jīròu.
short.working: 1 mark for fruit, 1 mark for meat, 1 mark for correct pinyin.

short.q: Name one kind of extreme weather. Say what causes it and give one safety tip.
short.answer: For example a flood: it is caused by too much heavy rain. Stay away from fast rivers. (A drought is caused by too little rain. Save water.)
short.working: 1 mark for the event, 1 mark for the cause, 2 marks for a safety tip with a reason.

short.q: Tell how to tell 大 dà from 太 tài by looking.
short.answer: 太 has an extra dot at the bottom right.
short.working: 1 mark for the dot and 1 mark for naming the two characters correctly.

short.q: Name two fruits, one vegetable and one drink in Chinese with pinyin.
short.answer: For example 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo, 菠菜 bōcài, 茶 chá.
short.working: 1 mark for fruits, 1 mark for vegetable, 1 mark for drink.

short.q: Answer the riddle in Chinese with pinyin: "I help you hear. I am on the sides of your head."
short.answer: 耳朵 ěrduo (ears).
short.working: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the pinyin.

short.q: Give three ways to make a reading club work well.
short.answer: Be kind and do not laugh at mistakes, listen while others read, take turns fairly and help others who find reading hard.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The chair is under the table."
short.answer: 椅子在桌子下。 yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喜欢 and 牛肉.
short.answer: 喜欢: xǐhuan, to like. 牛肉: niúròu, beef.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Sunday, go to church."
short.answer: 星期天,去教堂。 xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.
